reason: Conversation 1 immediately identified the pre-motor foam/felt filters as the most likely cause, gave correct safety-bounded washing instructions (unplug, water only, 24h dry, never refit damp), and the customer's findings confirmed the hidden truth with no part needed. Conversation 2 never asked about the filters at all, repeated a brush-bar check the customer had already completed, then wrongly escalated to 'internal seal or motor area' requiring a repairer — an unsupported direction that would have cost the homeowner money for a problem solved by a filter rinse.
